scope.stationInterpretation: Current takeoff has numeric station rows 0 to 1000, represented with assigned effective lengths. Reach boundary inferred from weights at 286 m; no claim that drawing revisions and station labels have been reconciled. Drawing plan p5 labels 0+000 to1+195; first/last cross-section labels differ.
scope.excluded: Third 222 m block and zero-length stations1025–1175 excluded from current totals.

basis: The app can reproduce sums from supplied cross-section areas and widths. This is not fresh CAD area extraction or proof of slope stability. Values from source inputs remain reported measurements/takeoff data, not app-generated geometry.
blankPolicy: Preserve null source cells. Arithmetic-only audit uses blank=0 as Excel multiplication/SUM does; null never certifies a physical zero. A missing quantity with present nonzero input is explicitly flagged.
